body:
**[comments] Rule 4, comment lines that map to no code line: move**

The panel, step, row and token sentences map to lines 112, 115, 113 and 110, which already carry the same fact in their trailing comments (next panel, 4 panels later, next 64-byte row, next 32-bit lane), so they are cut. The (17, 34) provenance maps to line 116, which has no comment: move it there as '// (17, 34) is the worked example of the 2026-09-04 single-K feasibility study.' above the STATIC_REQUIRE.
